verdict.rationale: decK provides declarative, plain-text (YAML/JSON) configuration for Kong's services, routes, and plugins that supports APIOps workflows, which is functionally similar to storing configuration in git-versioned text files — but Kong has no concept of 'collections' as in a request/collection workspace model, and the evidence never explicitly describes a git-based workflow or repo structure. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a git-versioning workflow for decK files, any mention of 'collections' as a first-class entity, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this text-file-plus-git pattern in practice.
